title: Unjamming Deferrals: Supporting Students Through JAMN Bot, a Mobile RAG-Grounded Policy Assistant
abstract: arXiv:2611.32266v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In some educational institutions, workflows such as the exam deferral process can be slow, inconvenient, and inconsistent, which creates the need to implement novel digital systems. This paper presents Schedulater, a mobile app for managing university exam deferrals. JAMN Bot is a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered chatbot integrated into Schedulater that provides context-aware support to help users understand the deferral process. The system features a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using Ollama (Llama 3.2 3B) for self-hosted inference which enables policy-grounded responses without sacrificing privacy. We evaluate the system using a 43-item benchmark spanning Exam Deferral, Privacy, Scheduling, Cross-Policy, and Adversarial & Out-of-Scope questions, and report inter-rater agreement among our human evaluators alongside retrieval hit-rate metrics. translated_title: 解除缓考阻塞：通过JAMN Bot——基于移动端RAG的政策助手支持学生
translated_abstract: 在一些教育机构中，诸如考试缓考申请流程之类的工作流程可能缓慢、不便且不一致，这产生了实施新型数字系统的需求。本文提出了Schedulater，一款用于管理大学考试缓考申请的移动应用。JAMN Bot是集成到Schedulater中的由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的聊天机器人，提供上下文感知的支持，帮助用户理解缓考流程。该系统采用基于Ollama（Llama 3.2 3B）的检索增强生成（RAG）管道进行自托管推理，能够在不牺牲隐私的情况下提供基于政策的回答。我们使用一个包含43个项目的基准测试来评估该系统，涵盖缓考、隐私、排期、跨政策以及对抗性和超范围问题，并报告了人类评估者之间的评分者间一致性以及检索命中率指标。随后，我们采用以GPT-5.4作为评判的LLM-as-a-judge方法，揭示了……
tldr: 本文提出了集成JAMN Bot的移动应用Schedulater，通过基于Ollama自托管Llama 3.2 3B的RAG管道，为大学缓考流程提供隐私保护的、基于政策的智能问答支持。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Schedulater, a mobile app integrating JAMN Bot, an RAG-grounded chatbot powered by self-hosted Llama 3.2 3B via Ollama, to provide privacy-preserving, policy-grounded support for university exam deferrals.
